crossRefs.note: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of…
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah…
and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
translations.bsb: After enlisting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join forces with him, Eglon attacked and defeated Israel, taking possession of the City of Palms.
translations.kjv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
translations.asv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and smote Israel, and they possessed the city of palm-trees.
